message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Inventory Adjustment Slope", "construction": "Slope of quarterly change in inventories (from Compustat, quarterly data) over the past eight quarters, normalized by beginning total assets.", "rationale": "Firms that begin to systematically reduce inventories may be signaling improved operational efficiency or anticipating demand trends before competitors.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with a large negative inventory adjustment slope"}, {"name": "Insider Option Grant Timing Abnormality", "construction": "Count of executive or director stock option grants (from SEC Form 4) during the 10 trading days following a 52-week stock price low, divided by the total number of option grants in the year.", "rationale": "Clustering of insider grants after price lows may signal superior information and undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with a higher proportion of grants following price lows"}, {"name": "Unrecognized R&D Growth", "construction": "Trailing three-year compound annual growth rate of R&D expense (from Compustat), scaled by lagged total assets, for firms not classified in tech or healthcare GICS sectors.", "rationale": "Rising R&D in non-traditional sectors may indicate a shift toward innovation undervalued by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high unrecognized R&D growth"}, {"name": "Cash Conversion Lag", "construction": "Difference in days between average receivables collection period (accounts receivable / sales * 365) and average payables period (accounts payable / cost of goods sold * 365), averaged over the last two fiscal years.", "rationale": "Shorter lags indicate better cash management and potentially greater flexibility in downturns.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low cash conversion lag"}, {"name": "Credit Market Spread Sensitivity", "construction": "Slope coefficient from rolling regression (36 monthly observations) of firm excess returns on monthly changes in the Baa-Treasury spread.", "rationale": "Stocks more negatively sensitive to credit spread widening may be underpriced in periods of credit stress.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with more negative spread sensitivity"}, {"name": "Normalized Ad Spend Intensity", "construction": "Advertising expense (from income statement, Compustat item XAD), averaged over past three fiscal years, divided by average total assets, for firms outside the media and consumer discretionary GICS sectors.", "rationale": "Firms in overlooked sectors investing in advertising may be building brand value unappreciated by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high normalized ad spend intensity"}, {"name": "Dividend Consistency Gap", "construction": "Absolute difference between the number of quarters with dividend increases and the number with dividend decreases, over the past 10 years.", "rationale": "Firms with consistently increasing dividends may enjoy higher investor trust and command a premium.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high consistency gap (many more increases than decreases)"}, {"name": "Patent Citation Momentum", "construction": "Trailing one-year change in the number of patent citations received (from USPTO data), normalized by previous year's citation count and lagged total assets.", "rationale": "Faster-growing patent citation rates may signal accelerating innovation not yet reflected in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high patent citation momentum"}, {"name": "Short-Term Lease Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year growth rate in operating lease obligations due within one year (from annual 10-K footnotes), divided by lagged total assets.", "rationale": "Rising short-term lease obligations may reflect management anticipation of near-term expansion or flexibility.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high short-term lease growth"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Delta", "construction": "Change in the percentage of revenue from the firm's largest customer, as disclosed in 10-K, over the past three years.", "rationale": "Firms reducing dependence on a single customer may be improving business stability and bargaining power.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with large negative customer concentration delta"}]}
